color.note: Six fixed brand colors, then semantic tokens per theme. Build UI from the semantic tokens; the brand six are for illustration, marketing and the cover.

tokens.name: sky-blue
tokens.usage: Brand Sky Blue (Trust · Open). Fixed in both themes. Primary action fills, progress, active states. Never as text on light grounds — use `link`.

tokens.name: deep-sky
tokens.usage: Brand Deep Sky (Confidence · Depth). Fixed in both themes. The wordmark, headings and navigation in light; text on `sky-blue`, `sunshine` and `mint` fills in either theme.

tokens.name: cloud-coral
tokens.usage: Brand Cloud Coral (Energy · Action). Fixed. Human warmth and rare attention moments — small doses only, never body text.

tokens.name: sunshine
tokens.usage: Brand Sunshine (Optimism · Ideas). Fixed. The spark: small emphasis, delight, the star beside the mascot.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Brand Mint (Growth · Balance). Fixed. Healthy and ready states, growth.

tokens.name: cloud-white
tokens.usage: Brand Cloud White (Clean · Focus). Fixed. The light canvas; text on `deep-sky` fills.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page canvas. Light theme is Cloud White.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, chat panel, menus, the composer.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells behind grouped tiles, code, the chat transcript background.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Inverse bands and the dark block on marketing pages; pair with `ink-inverse`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders, dividers (decorative — not for control edges).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; ≥3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and every *-soft tint. Light theme is Deep Sky.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps, metadata, placeholders, on the three surfaces (≥5.6:1).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `surface-inverse`.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, send button, progress ring, active tab indicator.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of `action`.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `action` fills (6.2:1). Never white — white on Sky Blue fails contrast.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and blue text on surfaces and `action-soft` (≥4.9:1).

tokens.name: action-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for Whumpo's chat bubbles, selected rows, info notes. Text on it: `ink` or `link`.

tokens.name: ready-soft
tokens.usage: Background of ready/live/healthy badges. Mint family.

tokens.name: ready-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `ready-soft`, and ready status text on surfaces (≥6:1).

tokens.name: spark-soft
tokens.usage: Background for highlights, tips and in-progress/pending badges. Sunshine family.

tokens.name: spark-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `spark-soft` (≥6.3:1).

tokens.name: attention-soft
tokens.usage: Background for errors, failed states and approvals that block work. Coral family.

tokens.name: attention-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `attention-soft` and error text on surfaces (≥5.6:1). Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring, 2px offset. ≥5:1 on every surface.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Poppins stands in for Poppins Rounded (not a published face). Marketing, onboarding and selected headings only.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: One per page: the marketing hero.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section openers on marketing pages, onboarding welcome.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The typeset wordmark beside the mark in the header and sidebar, in `ink`.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Inter for everything operational. Readable beats cute.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Got it. I’m checking that now.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense UI, tile text, secondary copy.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and the campaign line under the wordmark. Sparingly.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label in buttons; between badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between chat bubbles; tile inner gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), composer padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (default).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections in the workspace.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between marketing sections.

radius.note: Soft, rounded corners everywhere; pills for anything you click or read at a glance.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs inside cards, small tiles, icon wells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles, service tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Marketing blocks, hero media, the cover.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, the composer, avatars.

shadow.note: Cloud-light: soft, wide, blue-tinted. Darker and tighter in dark theme.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Tiles, the composer.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Cards and the chat panel.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and approval sheets.
